demos.say: Kivi vasemmalle, lehti oikealle. Vaaka heilahtaa ja asettuu: kivi painuu alas, joten kivi on painavampi.
demos.label: Vaaka: vasemmalla kivi, oikealla lehti

demos.say: Iso ei aina ole painava. Kolme isoa lehteä vasemmalle, pieni kivi oikealle. Kivi painaa vaa'an alas.
demos.label: Vaaka: vasemmalla lehti, lehti, lehti, oikealla kivi

demos.say: Kun molemmilla puolilla on yhtä paljon painoa, vaaka jää suoraan.
demos.label: Vaaka: vasemmalla simpukka, simpukka, oikealla simpukka, simpukka

assumptions: Zeroed equal-arm balance with equal pan masses and common local gravity.
Each manually chosen stage represents a settled position; angle magnitude is not calibrated mass.
Model masses describe these packages, not all objects of that appearance. Kilogram transfer omitted from core.
planning.scope: Four fixed bounded pairs: masses2/5,5/2,4/4,2/5 internally; visible sizes independent; no numeric mass reading.
planning.interaction: Load both packages in one action or step through A then B; reverse pan sides; compare stable identities.
planning.concreteToRepresentation: Physical comparison and teacher procedure → original diagram → controllable same-quantity model → short practice/feedback → transfer/offline discussion.
planning.evidenceLimit: Local supported low-stakes comparison only; no real-object competence, learner data, formal mastery, retention or efficacy claim.
